texts: good. "together" is read as one joint lighting by the keepers rather than one lighting each, and day 3, Year 1 and sundown are all carried.
good. "that night" is resolved to the night of day 3 of Year 1 from the previous sentence, and the plural subject also yields a fireable per-keeper rule.
good. the group burning is recorded together with a fireable per-lantern rule, and mire-essence is filed as a kind of essence.
good. "Together" keeps this one joint producing, and the mist-light gets its own referent that the next two sentences reuse.
good. the same mist-light referent is reused, "at night" is carried, and a fireable per-lantern rule is added.
good. the definite mist-light links back to the previous sentence, and the nightmoths become a specific set the later sentences refer to again.
good. read as a subset of the nightmoths already introduced, with the gathering treated as collective rather than one gathering per moth.
good. the landing is recorded for the set and, through a fireable rule, for each moth in it, with the lanterns as the place.

mixed: everything in the sentence is carried, but the parse files the threads as something the leaving created or altered rather than as something deposited unchanged, so a later question about what the moths left behind looks in the wrong slot. Making the depositing explicit fixes it: "The nightmoths deposited silken threads on the lanterns."
good. Pell, the threads, the lanterns as the place they came from, and dawn on day 4 of Year 1 are all carried.
good. all participants are carried, with the boiling treated as changing the threads and the sea-water as what it was boiled in.
good. "by evening" is recorded as a deadline (no later than evening), and the mire-essence gets a referent the next sentence reuses.
good. the two clay vessels are counted as a pair, and the mire-essence links back to the previous sentence.
good. "the stored mire-essence" links back to what Hesper stored, and the unmarked plural subject yields a fireable per-keeper rule alongside the group lighting.
